fit_reason: Seller is offering the car as a full parts car with the supercharger removed and a mechanical misfire issue, so a pre-sale cosmetic detail is not relevant to how it sells.
findings: Red paint on the hood, doors and quarter panels shows a strong, even gloss in both garage and outdoor shots
Black wheels and tires look new and clean
Headlight lenses on the front view look clear
Black front grille and lower vent trim look dark, not faded
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the red S5. The paint on the hood and doors already looks glossy and the new black wheels are sharp. If you ever decide to sell it as a running car instead of for parts, we do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you. Would you like a quote at that point?
